title: Baked Buffalo Mac and Cheese

items.text: ¾ cup buffalo sauce (like Frank’s RedHot)
3 tbsp blue cheese or ranch dressing, for drizzling

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 375°F. Grease a 9×13-inch baking dish.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the 16 oz macaroni 1–2 minutes less than the package says (about 8 minutes) — it finishes in the oven. Drain and set aside.
In the same pot, melt the 4 tbsp butter over medium heat. Whisk in the 4 tbsp flour. Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly.
steps.donenessCue: Smells slightly nutty and turns light golden.

steps.text: Slowly pour in the 2 cups milk and 1 cup cream, whisking constantly. Keep whisking 3–4 minutes.
Reduce heat to low. Add the 3 cups cheddar and 1 cup Monterey Jack a handful at a time, stirring until smooth. Stir in the ¾ cup buffalo sauce, 1 tsp garlic powder, and ½ tsp salt.
Add the drained pasta to the sauce and stir until fully coated.
Pour into the baking dish, spread evenly, and sprinkle the ½ cup panko over the top.

steps.donenessCue: Top golden, bubbling at the edges.

steps.text: Rest 5 minutes. Top with the sliced green onions and drizzle with the 3 tbsp blue cheese or ranch.

ifYouFeelLikeIt: Fold in 1½ cups cooked, shredded chicken when you combine the pasta and sauce.
Milder: cut the buffalo sauce to ½ cup and add more cheddar.
storage: Make ahead: assemble through the panko step up to a day ahead, cover, and refrigerate. Add 10 minutes to the bake time if it goes in cold.
